reviews.name: John M.
reviews.text: Max redesigned our onboarding flow and sign-up conversion jumped from 18% to 31%. Communicative, sharp, and truly understood our vision. Highly recommend!

reviews.text: Working with Max was great. He revamped our landing page — bounce rate dropped by 24%. Clean designs, fast delivery, always open to feedback. Will hire again.

reviews.name: Alex R.
reviews.text: Max brought our product to life with his designs. Very professional and detail-oriented, with a great sense for what users actually need. Exceeded our expectations.

reviews.text: Excellent mobile app design from Max. He nailed the brief — after release, our App Store rating went from 3.8 to 4.7. High quality, delivered on time.

reviews.name: Maria L.
reviews.text: Working with Max is always a pleasure. Strong eye for detail, polished and modern style. Our checkout redesign cut drop-off by 19%. A designer you can trust.

reviews.text: Max is one of the best designers I've worked with on Upwork. Creative, fast, and professional — every screen felt intentional and well thought out.
